collision_energy.evidence: The normalized collision energy was set to 27%, the mass isolation window was set to 1.4 m/z and one microscan was acquired for each spectrum.

enrichment_method.evidence: cell extracts were incubated at 4°C with Anti-FLAG M2 Affinity Gel (Sigma-Aldrich) for 2 h

fragmentation_method.evidence: Each MS1 scan was followed by high-collision-dissociation of the 10 most abundant precursor ions with dynamic exclusion for 20 s.

reduction_reagent.evidence: reduced in 5 mM Tris-2-carboxyethyl-phosphin (TCEP) for 10 min at 95°C
